traces.notes: Kokkos-accelerated reaxff/kk pair style, GPU backend (CUDA/HIP/SYCL via Kokkos). One MPI rank typically mapped to one GPU (local-rank modulo ngpus); comm buffers stay device-resident and use GPU-aware MPI when available (gpu_aware_flag=1 default on GPU builds). Full neighbor lists forced on GPU to reduce reverse comm.
